obligations.source_text: Create a photorealistic vertical editorial fashion photograph inside a wind-carved basalt alcove with a shallow black-stone reflecting basin. One unmistakably adult woman with balanced oval facial proportions, a softly tapered jaw, long dark wavy hair, and visible natural skin texture sits at the basin edge with both feet grounded at different depths. She holds a poised, stable figure-study position. A single length of opaque smoke-violet silk twill is the complete outfit and sole coverage mechanism: it begins at the upper back, passes securely over one shoulder and across the chest, continues around the torso and pelvis, then settles across the lap with a clearly tensioned terminal fold anchored beneath the nearer thigh. The same continuous textile remains visibly opaque, substantial, and structurally connected throughout its path. Its two readable edges track plausible body contour, while the opposite arm, both lower legs, the basin support, and the bend of the seated pose remain easy to parse. One hand rests on basalt for support and the other lightly maintains the terminal fold at the hip. A low raking sunset beam enters from frame-right, with dim blue ambient fill revealing fabric thickness, edge shadows, skin texture, and body-bounded negative spaces. Frame the complete figure with a 58 mm lens in a vertical 2:3 composition, balancing sculptural geometry with natural photographic detail.

bindings.figure_coverage_adult_phrase: One unmistakably adult figure is the complete study subject, framed from head through torso to both grounded feet.
bindings.figure_coverage_carrier_phrase: One opaque drape wrap or integrated form is the primary visible carrier of non-explicit coverage, realized as one smoke-violet silk-twill wrap.
bindings.figure_coverage_path_phrase: One stable opaque coverage path remains continuous over non-explicit anatomy from upper back across chest, torso, pelvis, and lap.
bindings.figure_coverage_necessity_phrase: The carrier is visibly the complete outfit, establishing that no separate fully opaque full-body garment makes that coverage carrier visually redundant.
bindings.figure_coverage_contour_phrase: Body contour continues plausibly around both edges of the occluding form, with readable form before and after each textile edge.
bindings.figure_coverage_light_phrase: Directional light and continuous body-bounded negative space model three-dimensional form around the wrap and seated adult figure.
bindings.figure_coverage_frame_phrase: Head torso support limbs and pose remain readable as one holistic figure study, including both arms, both legs, and the basin edge.
